findings.passage: It is not an inconvenience to get a state-issued photo ID. This is the bare minimum for making sure only legal citizens who are registered to vote are actually the only people voting.
findings.note: Answer to the iVoterGuide 2024-cycle question 'People should be able to vote without photo identification' (he marked Strongly Disagree). He ties photo ID to making sure only legal citizens who are registered vote. Exact answer date not printed.

findings.passage: There is no way to verify the identification document belongs to the person trying to vote without a photo. It's nonsensical that this isn't the law in all fifty states.
findings.note: Answer to the iVoterGuide 2026 General Election question 'People should be able to vote without photo identification' (Strongly Disagree). He says a photo is needed to verify the ID belongs to the voter and that photo ID should be law in every state. Exact answer date not printed.
